properties.boundedRegion: United Kingdom (Great Britain and Northern Ireland)

rejectedUnnamedPasses.rule: A mountain_pass=yes node with no name is not published. OpenStreetMap uses the tag for ordinary local hill saddles, and a name is the only signal in the extract that separates those from a real pass.

properties.warning: Discovery highlights are descriptive and are not safety endorsements. Check current access, closures, weather and road conditions.
properties.enforcementNote: Average speed check and camera fields report what OpenStreetMap records, and each carries a provenance and a note. Absence means not recorded, not absence of enforcement: OpenStreetMap holds one average-speed relation for the whole United Kingdom extract, while the A57 Snake Pass has published average speed camera proposals it does not record.
properties.speedLimitNote: Speed limits carry provenance: tagged, inferred-from-maxspeed-type, or unknown. An unknown limit is not an unrestricted road.
properties.busyPeriodsNote: busyPeriods carries a provenance of researched or not-researched. not-researched means nobody has checked, not that the road is quiet.
properties.sourceVerificationNote: On a researched candidate, sourceVerification is `fetched` when the cited page was retrieved and the claim read off it, or `listing-only` when the URL resolves and the claim is limited to what the listing establishes. motorcycleEvidence `none-found` records that a search was done and found nothing.

editorialOverlay.note: Researched names, rider notes, motorcycle evidence and busy periods come from editorial-overlay.json and are merged here. They are re-matched by sourceFeatureId when candidate ids change, so a regeneration cannot destroy them.
